'''Mistress Huldin''' is the wife of an Andoran weaver, [[Kely Huldin]]. She is round-faced and has two children.

Her husband comes to [[Caemlyn]] to answer Rand's amnesty. Once Rand brings [[Taim]] to the farm and the Saldaean starts testing the men, Mistress Huldin tries to talk her husband out of partaking. 

She is more than relieved when it turns out that he cannot learn to channel and consoles him.
